result.topic_en: Riemann discusses special simplest forms of the operators Δ and Λ satisfying ΔΛ = θΔ, showing that when the initial temperature satisfies Δu=0 this persists in time, and then treats the case where an additional differential equation θu=0, independent of Δu=0, can be derived, reducing to equations in derivatives with respect to a single variable or with respect to t.
